summary: Every public array query parameter (9 on spec.yaml at reprint 637: email, tag, tagId on contacts list, contacts get-count, contacts export) is a repeatable StringArrayVar flag sent as one key per value via appendRepeatableArrayQueryParam; the literal --cf-key flag (cf[<key>]) is not registered and its MCP bindings are removed; --cf stays the documented custom-field filter. Prose note: .printing-press-patches/reprint-637-repeatable-array-query-params.md.
reason: 4.28.0 prints exploded array query params as single string flags (one comma-joined value) and the deep-object cf[<key>] as a literal parameter name the API never reads.
validated_outcome: For every array query param in spec.yaml the flag is a stringArray and three occurrences reach the API as repeated keys; no command registers --cf-key and the manifest has no cf[<key>]. TestEveryArrayQueryParamIsRepeatable, TestLiteralCfKeyFlagIsAbsent.
upstream_issue: For the press board (not filed): emit repeatable flags for exploded array query params; skip or expand deep-object params.
